media:group.media:title: The Future of Universities: Lifelong Learning for a Radically Complex World
media:group.media:description:
12 November 2026 - This Global Lecture features ETH Alumnus and Founder of the World Economic Forum, Klaus Schwab, in conversation with the Vice Rector for Continuing Education of ETH Zurich, Stefano Brusoni. Join us for a timely discussion on how higher education must evolve to meet the demands of the AI age, lifelong learning and a world defined by constant change.
